_about: Public-domain Allan Pearson Shatford (1873-1935), rector of the Church of St James the Apostle, Montreal, for the Word Hoard: his Christmas studies and parables (The Three Kings of Orient, The Innocents, The Return, Our Lady of Colours), The Church and the Book, The Priest and the People, The Four Marys, The Keystone and the Arch, The Year of Jubilee, The Light of Life, Duty and Faith (war sermons), Sermons, and Six Marks of a Christian. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 117 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
